title: Spinach Filo Tart
subtitle: with Bulgarian feta and cheese custard
description: A filo pastry shell filled with fresh spinach and crumbled feta, topped with an egg, cream and cheese custard and crinkled filo scraps, baked until golden.

steps.text: Brush a filo sheet with melted butter, lay another sheet on top and brush it, and finish with a third buttered sheet. Line a tart tin with the layered sheet and trim off the excess (keep the scraps).
Arrange the finely sliced spinach over the pastry shell and crumble the feta over it.
In a bowl whisk the eggs, cream and grated yellow cheese, season with salt and pepper and pour over the spinach. Crinkle the filo scraps and place on top of the filling.
Bake for about 40 minutes until the tart is golden.
